lg - 32\" 4k uhd 60hz 5ms smart monitor.description: Smart Display. Serious Performance. Seamless Entertainment. Experience the flexibility of a monitor that does more. The LG Smart Monitor features a 31.5" 4K UHD (3840x2160) IPS display with built-in webOS, giving you seamless access to streaming, productivity tools, and cloud gaming—no PC required. Work, watch, and play from one streamlined screen. Enjoy sharp detail and vibrant color with HDR10 and up to 90% DCI-P3 coverage. Powered by the alpha 7 AI Processor 4K Gen9, the monitor automatically enhances picture and sound—improving clarity, balancing brightness, and refining audio for a more consistent experience. AI Picture Pro sharpens content toward 4K quality with AI Super Upscaling, while Dynamic Tone Mapping Pro optimizes brightness and detail across every scene. AI Sound Pro delivers virtual 11.1.2 channel surround sound and separates dialogue, music, and effects for clearer voices and richer, more balanced audio. With webOS¹, stream from apps like Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, YouTube, and Apple TV, or explore LG Channels for live and on-demand content. Browse LG’s Gaming Portal² and access cloud gaming services like Xbox Cloud Gaming, GeForce NOW, and Amazon Luna—no console needed. Control it all with the AI Magic Remote³ using motion, scrolling, and voice input. AI Voice ID recognizes your voice to deliver personalized recommendations instantly, creating a smarter experience for multiple users. Work smarter with built-in apps, remote PC access, and multitasking tools like LG Switch⁴ for screen splitting and quick settings. Auto Brightness Control adjusts to your environment for clear viewing day or night. Dual HDMI 2.0 and USB-A ports support multiple devices, keeping your setup clean and connected. With AI-powered enhancements, built-in streaming, and versatile connectivity, the LG Smart Monitor adapts to how you work and unwind.
